proposed.command: mise roster run roast-commander --dept operations-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: ticket with doneness target, heat / load reading, timer, protein or batch on the pass → outputs: cooked-to-spec item, doneness check, heat log, escalation if the line runs hot; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Most of the brigade only notices Roast Commander when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Roast Commander runs the high-heat line: controls flame, timing and doneness so pressure never turns into burn; the image the crew uses for it is the flat-top at the peak of Friday service. The card calls out Oven Core, Roast Control, Maillard: the checks Roast Commander runs before calling anything ready. In the canon crosswalk this card is a provisional match for Scale Oni.
